import os, shutil
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

SANDBOX_ROOT = '/vaults/nvme0/qsb_tower_v1/data/team_sandbox/'

def create_snapshot(sandbox_path):
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')
    snapshot_dir = f'{sandbox_path}/snapshots/{timestamp}'
    os.makedirs(snapshot_dir)
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(sandbox_path):
        for file in files:
            src_file = os.path.join(root, file)
            dst_file = os.path.join(snapshot_dir, os.path.relpath(src_file, sandbox_path))
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst_file), exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(src_file, dst_file)

def cleanup_stale_sandboxes():
    cutoff = datetime.now() - timedelta(days=7)
    for root, dirs, _ in os.walk(SANDBOX_ROOT):
        for d in dirs:
            p = os.path.join(root, d)
            if os.path.getmtime(p) < cutoff.timestamp():
                shutil.rmtree(p)
